source: Vogel, J.V. (1968), Inflow Performance Relationships for Solution-Gas Drive Wells, Journal of Petroleum Technology 20(1), SPE-1476 — worked example 'Use of Reference Curve' (copy hosted in the Texas A&M PETE 613 course archive)
source_check: Values read from the OCR text of the paper on 2026-10-18; the OCR prints '65 130PD' (= 65 BOPD) and '1,530/2,000' (= 1,500/2,000).
description: Vogel's example: 65 BOPD at pwf = 1,500 psi, p̄r = 2,000 psi → (qo)max = 162 BOPD (the paper reads qo/qmax = 0.40 from its Fig. 5).
tolerance_justification: The paper reads qo/qmax = 0.40 from a chart to two decimals (±0.005), so 65/0.40 is only known to 65/0.405…65/0.395 = 160.5…164.6, and the result is printed as an integer: ±2.1 BOPD.
